description: Copies of the match backups on USB sticks: the scoretable window (loaded from the built-in server on http://localhost) may list the sticks present (by an opaque id, never a path), copy one of its own backup files to <stick>/OpenVolley (OpenBeach: <stick>/OpenBeach) and list, read and delete files there only. LAN tablets and the scoresheet windows never get these commands.
